notes.title: Fine-Tuned After the Steam Next Fest – Small Touches, Big Changes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’re back with another exciting update for Photographer’s Life Simulator! This patch brings not only immersive improvements to the atmosphere but also introduces fresh gameplay mechanics that add more depth to your experience.

New Features:

Studio Lighting Improvements – Previously dark corners are now brightly lit, making your workspace feel more open and vibrant.

Redesigned Photo Scoring System – Scoring is now more balanced and detailed, better reflecting your photography skills.

Floor Sweeping Mechanic – Keep your shop clean and tidy with this new interactive cleaning feature.

Camera View Mechanic – You can now look directly through your camera lens to frame the perfect shot.

Photo Printing System – Photos you take are now printed in real-time on your in-game printer!

Customer Orders & Fulfillment – Meet the unique demands of your customers and make each order count.

End-of-Day & Sleep System – After a long day, head home and rest to prepare for the next.

Pause Employees Mechanic – Temporarily stop your employees when needed for better management.

Cartridge System – When ink runs out, replace the cartridge and keep printing without interruption.

Daily Expenses – Keep an eye on your shop’s economy! You now have daily payments to manage, such as income tax, staff salaries, rent, and electricity bills.

Bug Fixes:

Various minor bugs have been fixed to improve overall stability.

As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable to us.
Don't forget to test out the new mechanics and share your best screenshots with us!
We’ve also updated the visuals on our Steam store page check them out!

Happy shooting!
— The Photographer's Life Simulator Team

notes.title: Mini Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Today we're rolling out a small but meaningful update. This patch includes several bug fixes, performance improvements, and some quality-of-life enhancements to make your gameplay experience even smoother.

 Helpful Reminders:
We noticed that some players were missing or forgetting about the customer request section, which often led to poor-quality shots. To help with this, we've added a subtle reminder panel (visible in the photos below) that will appear during gameplay to keep you on track.

 New Features:
A new progression system has been added that allows players to gain experience and level up as they play. As you level up, your skills improve, adding a deeper sense of progression and mastery to the game.

 Demo Content Expanded:
We've added a cashier to the demo version who works in your store. This gives players access to more content and a better feel for store management mechanics.

Your feedback means a lot to us—don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!

Happy playing! 
– The Photographer's Life Simulator Team
